name: Axiom Ax-3
about: Axiom Ax-3 (2024-014A), a crewed vehicle (Dragon 2), launched 2024 Jan 18. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2024 Jan 18), held fixed
docked to A08583; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
